title: Drydocking & Refit Services for the M.V. Highlanders
brief_description: Marine Atlantic Inc. Request for Proposal #305-379-026 Drydocking & Refit Services for the M.V. Highlanders Marine Atlantic Inc. (“MAI”) invites proposals from suppliers for Drydocking & Refit Services. MAI is looking for a supplier to provide drydocking, refit, inspection, maintenance, repair, and preservation services for the MV Highlanders, including all required shipyard services, labour, facilities, equipment, project coordination, and support necessary to perform the work. Services include vessel inspections, mechanical and electrical maintenance, structural repairs, coating and preservation activities, safety equipment servicing, and associated class and regulatory certification activities. The M.V. Highlanders is available to come out of service for refit during the period April 7, 2027, to May 31, 2027 (the “Available Out of Service Period”). Marine Atlantic reserves the right to accept proposals in whole or in part.  The lowest priced, or any, proposal will not necessarily be accepted.   The closing for receipt of proposals will be 2:00 pm Atlantic Time, September 14, 2026. title: Collaborative Interface and Prototyping Design Tool
brief_description: This bid solicitation 1000439295/A cancels and supersedes previous bid solicitation number 1000439295 dated September 17, 2024 with a closing of October 16, 2024 at 02:00 PM EDT. The Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) intends to enter into a contract with a single contractor to provide 40 user licenses for a Software as a Service ( Saas) Subscription based Licenses for a cloud-based interface design and prototyping tool to support the creation, modification, and collaboration of internal and external CRA digital content, including static and interactive designs for intranet, secure portal, and Canada.ca pages. While the CRA currently uses various software design tools that are adequate for prototyping, these tools do not allow seamless collaboration among project team members. As a result, designs must often be exported into shareable formats such as PowerPoint or PDF for review by team members who do not have access to the design software. Suppliers who consider themselves fully qualified and available to provide the goods described in the ACAN may submit a Statement of Capabilities in writing on or before the closing date specified in the notice. The Statement of Capabilities must clearly demonstrate how the supplier meets all mandatory requirements identified in the ACAN.
